verdict.rationale: Floot documents jobs that run on a schedule without a server (time-based triggers). Generated apps can receive email and send push notifications, and the AI assistant can build integrations with endpoints on request. That gives building blocks for automatic actions, but there is no documented rules or event-trigger system. Missing for 10: a documented event-based trigger mechanism (e.g. webhooks, DB-change or inbound-email triggers), user-definable rule configuration, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
